name: bardiyah
description: Connect ChatGPT to your own ideas, projects and video scripts in Bardiyah.

interface.longDescription: Bardiyah is a workspace for content creators. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your own ideas, projects and video scripts so you can search them, create them, and build a script section by section. It also plans production: shoot days, filming locations, equipment, storyboards, thumbnail briefs and a publishing schedule. Works fully in Arabic and English. Sign in with OAuth. The plugin cannot delete anything and has no access to billing information.
defaultPrompt: Show me all my content ideas in Bardiyah.
Create a script called Discovering AlUla in Bardiyah.
